surrogate_gap.stronger_valid_source_semantics: A qualified background pixel certifies that the full admitted camera ray segment contains no subject geometry.
surrogate_gap.finding: Using only the ray minimum discards the pointwise empty-space authority of background rays. It supplies gradient primarily through the most negative depth sample and does not directly require every sampled point on a known-background ray to remain positive.
